content: भू I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (rarely <ab>Ā.</ab>) (भवति, बभूव, अभूत्, भविष्यति, भवितुम्, भूत) .²1 To be, become; कथमेवं भवेन्नाम; अस्याः किमभवत् <ls>Māl. 9. 29</ls> ‘what has become her fate’, ‘what has become of her’ <ls>U. 3. 27</ls>; यद्भावि तद्भवतु <ls>U. 3</ls> ‘come what may’; so दुःखितो भवति, हृष्टो भवति <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To be born or produced; यदपत्यं भवेदस्याम् <ls>Ms. 9. 127</ls>; भाग्यक्रमेण हि धनानि भवन्ति यान्ति <ls>Mk. 1. 13</ls>. .²3 To spring or proceed from, arise; क्रोधाद् भवति संमोहः <ls>Bg. 2. 63</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">14. 17</ls>. .²4 To happen, take place, occur; नाततायिवधे दोषो हन्तुर्भवति कश्चन <ls>Ms. 8. 351</ls>; यदि संशयो भवेत् <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 To live, exist; अभूदभूतपूर्वः … राजा चिन्तामणिर्नाम <ls>Vās.</ls>; अभून्नृपो विबुधसखः परंतपः <ls>Bk. 1. 1</ls>. .²6 To be alive or living, breathe; त्वमिदानीं न भविष्यसि <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; आः चारुदत्तहतक, अयं न भवसि <ls>Mk. 4</ls>; दुगत्मन्, प्रहर नन्वयं न भवसि <ls>Māl. 5</ls> (‘thou art a dead man’, thou shalt breathe no longer); ऋतेऽपि त्वा न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे <ls>Bg. 11. 32</ls>. .²7 To remain or be in any state or condition, fare; भवान् स्थले कथं भविष्यति <ls>Pt. 2</ls>. .²8 To stay, abide; remain; अस्मिन्नेव लतागृहे त्वमभवस्तन्मार्गदत्तेक्षणः <ls>U. 3. 37</ls>. .²9 To serve, do; इदं पादोदकं भविष्यति <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²10 To be possible (usually with a future tense in this sense); भवति भवान् याजयिष्यति <ls>Sk.</ls> .²11 To lead or tend to, conduce to, bring about (with <ab>dat.</ab>); वाताय कपिला विद्युत् … … पीता भवति सस्याय दुर्भिक्षाय सिता भवेत् <ls>Mbh.</ls>; सुखाय तज्जन्मदिनं बभूव <ls>Ku. 1. 23</ls>; संस्मृतिर्भव भवत्यभवाय <ls>Ki. 18. 27</ls>; न तस्या रुचये बभूव <ls>R. 6. 44</ls>. .²12 To be on the side of, assist; देवा अर्जुनतोऽभवन् . .²13 To belong or pertain to (often expressed by ‘have’); तस्य ह शतं जाया बभूवुः <ls>Ait. Br.</ls>; तस्य तेजोमया लोका भवन्ति ब्रह्मवादिनः <ls>Ms. 6. 39</ls>. .²14 To be engaged in, be occupied (with <ab>loc.</ab>); चरणक्षालने कृष्णो ब्राह्मणानां स्वयं ह्यभूत् <ls>Mb.</ls> .²15 To conduct oneself, behave. .²16 <ab>Ved.</ab> To be prosperous, succeed; ततो देवा अभवन् <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 3. 7</ls>; <ls>Mb. 12. 228. 1</ls>. Used with a preceding noun or adjective भू serves to form verbs in the sense of ‘becoming what it previously is not’ or ‘becoming’ in general; श्वेतीभू to become white; कृष्णीभू to become black; पयोधरीभूत ‘becoming or serving the purpose of teats’; so क्षपणीभू to be or become a mendicant; प्रणिधीभू to act the spy; आर्द्रीभू to melt; भस्मीभू to be reduced to ashes; विषयीभू to form the subject of; so एकमतीभू; तरुणीभू <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab> {%Note%}:-- The senses of भू may be variously modified according to the adverbs with which it is connected; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} पुनर्भू to marry again; आविर्भू to appear, arise, to be evident or clear; see आविस्; तिरोभू to disappear; प्रादुर्भू to arise, be visible, appear; अग्रेभू to be in front, take the lead; अन्तर्भू to be absorbed or included; ओजस्यन्तर्भवन्त्यन्ये <ls>K. P. 8</ls>; दोषाभू to grow evening or dusk-time; अन्यथा भू to be otherwise, be changed; न मे वचनमन्यथा भवितुमर्हति <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; पुरो भू to come forward; stand forth; मिथ्या भू to turn out false; वृथा भू to become useless <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab> --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (भावयति-ते) .²1 To cause to be or become, call into existence, call into being; ते वै ब्रह्मण आदेशात् कथमेतदभावयन् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 20. 10</ls>. .²2 To cause, produce, effect. .²3 To manifest, display, exhibit. .²4 To foster, cherish, support, preserve, enliven; पुनः सृजति वर्षाणि भगवान् भावयन् प्रजाः <ls>Mb.</ls>; देवान् भावयतानेन ते देवा भाव्यन्तु वः . परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ .. <ls>Bg. 3. 11</ls>; <ls>Bk. 16. 27</ls>. .²5 To think or reflect, consider, fancy, imagine. .²6 To look upon, consider or regard as; अर्थमनर्थं भावय नित्यम् <ls>Moha M. 2</ls>. .²7 To prove, substantiate, establish; निह्नवे भावितो दद्याद्धनं राज्ञे च तत्समम् <ls>Y. 2. 11</ls>. .²8 To purify. .²9 To get, obtain. .²10 To mingle or mix. .²11 To change or transform into. .²12 To soak, steep. .²13 To devote or addict oneself to. .²14 To convince. .²15 To perfume, scent. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (बुभूषति) To wish to be or become <ab>&c.</ab> --II. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (भवति-ते) To get, obtain. --III. €10 <ab>Ā.</ab> (भावयते) To obtain, gain. --IV. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (भावयति-ते) .²1 To think, reflect. .²2 To mix, mingle. .²3 To be purified (connected with <ab>caus.</ab> of भू <ab>q. v.</ab> above).

भू {%a.%} (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Being, existing, becoming, springing from, arising or produced from, <ab>&c.</ab>; चित्तभू, आत्मभू, कमलभू, मनोभू <ab>&c.</ab> --{%m.%} .²1 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²2 The sacrificial fire.

भूः {%f.%} [भू-क्विप्] .²1 The earth (<ab>opp.</ab> अन्तरीक्ष or स्वर्ग); दिवं मरुत्वानिव भोक्ष्यते भुवम् <ls>R. 3. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 4</ls>; <ls>Me. 18</ls>; मत्तेभकुम्भदलने भुवि सन्ति शूराः . .²2 Earth as one of the nine substances. .²3 The universe, globe. .²4 Ground, floor; मणिभयभुवः (प्रासादाः) <ls>Me. 66</ls>. .²5 Land, landed property. .²6 A place, site, region, plot of ground; काननभुवि, उपवनभुवि <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 Matter, subject-matter. .²8 A symbolical expression for the number ‘one’. .²9 The base of a geometrical figure. .²10 A sacrificial fire. .²11 The act of becoming, arising. .²12 The first of the three Vyāhṛtis or mystic syllables (भूः, भुवः, स्वः)--representing the earth--repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at the commencement of his daily Sandhyā.  .{@-प(फ)लः@} a kind of rat (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>घूस</ns>).
